newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire's Mobutu to leave Kinshasa on Wednesday-CNN.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu to leave Kinshasa on Wednesday-CNN.

text.p: Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko, under pressure to resign as rebels close in on Kinshasa, will leave the capital on Wednesday but intends to return, Cable News Network reported on Tuesday.

Mobutu will fly to Gabon's capital Libreville on Wednesday under the pretext of attending a Great Lake regional summit, CNN said, quoting Western diplomats in Kinshasa. Mobutu reportedly intended to return on Friday but the network said the trip was apparently part of a deal to allow rebel leader Laurent Kabila to take over power.
